title: When the Oath Breaks
author: Theo Lockridge
blurb: Juniper Okafor, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
